title: One finite-free open-site stalk map lifts on one neighbourhood
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open containing x, and S_A the ambient-ring-valued open module stalk functor [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. Let F be the rank-m finite free module sheaf on the U slice [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], N any module sheaf on that slice [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and t:S_U(F) → S_U(N) any linear map. There exist x ∈ V ⊆ U, a natural isomorphism a:R_{VU}S_V ≅ S_U for slice restriction R [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and k:R(F) → R(N), such that S_V(k)=a_F t a_N inverse in categorical composition order. The comparison can depend on m,N,t; no uniform family of comparisons or lifting on every smaller open is asserted.

source.place: Modules Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, finite-generator portion of the finite-presentation proof; Sheaves Tag 00A0 (3). Read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00A0 on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Identify the U slice with sheaves on the open subscheme U, preserving the unit and finite coproducts, hence the finite free source. Transport t across the open-immersion stalk-ring isomorphism. Apply finite-free local stalk-map lifting on U.toScheme with the identity source map: choose the finitely many image germs, represent them by sections, intersect neighbourhoods and form the free-source morphism. Rank zero uses V=U and the zero-source map.

Transport this morphism back through the slice equivalence. Use the canonical restriction-stalk comparison a, whose germ formula sends the restricted section to the same germ. Equality on the finite basis germs and linearity give S(k) followed by a_N equals a_F followed by t. Compose with a_N inverse.

proof_origin.place: Modules Tag 01CP and Sheaves Tag 00A0 (3); the identity-source finite-coordinate lifting argument, transported through the slice/open equivalence and stalk-ring isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_stalk_free_map_one_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (m : ℕ) (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (t : (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m))) ⟶
      (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).obj N) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
      let R := SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU)
      let S := openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      let F := SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m))
      ∃ (a : R ⋙ S ≅ openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩)
        (k : R.obj F ⟶ R.obj N),
        S.map k = a.hom.app F ≫ t ≫ a.inv.app N
